sources.title: Qwen3-VL-4B Heretic: Uncensored Text Encoder for Krea 2 in ComfyUI
sources.snippet: DreamFast has released Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct Heretic (ComfyUI), a fully abliterated version of the Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct text encoder packaged specifically for ComfyUI. The model removes safety guardrails while preserving output quality, achieving a 100% HarmBench ASR (Attack Success Rate) compared to the base model's 30.8% — with minimal benchmark regression. sources.snippet: An abliterated Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct released across three formats with forensics comparing four Heretic trials. The winner achieves 100% HarmBench compliance with near-zero KL divergence.
